honest_bounds: The marker-presence assertions stay (they name WHAT the artifact must carry); they are no longer the freshness proof.

The arm spawns `node scripts/verify-dist-fresh.mjs` — the canonical gate — instead of hand-rolling a build+diff, so the reading cannot drift from the gate's definition of fresh. The gate's --only filter matching no target is a zero-subject FAILURE, so a red here cannot be a silent skip.
The two dists are rebuilt on demand by lane B's T-67 script half; a later manifest edit requires a re-check of both dists (already sequenced in the lane-A plan).
